## Description
Provide a clear and concise description of the 3D fitting or deformation problem.

## Observed Behavior
- Garment stiffness: (e.g. rigid deformation, lack of natural draping)
- Clipping / Penetration: (e.g. skin clipping through shirt on specific poses)
- Weight painting / Rigging: (e.g. vertices stretching unnaturally)
- Texture mapping / UVs: (e.g. decal distortion, texture stretching)

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Open `fitting-room.php`
2. Select apparel item / preset: `[e.g. Oversize Hoodie, Malam Minggu]`
3. Rotate or zoom the 3D viewport
4. Observe the artifact / defect

## Expected Visual Behavior
Explain how the garment should drape, wrinkle, and fit according to human anatomy.

## Environment
- OS: [e.g. Windows 11, macOS, Linux]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome, Firefox, Safari]
- GPU / WebGL Version: [e.g. WebGL 2.0]
- Three.js Version: r128 (vendor bundled)
